text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$104,088 to NT$96,691, so I should assess the portfolio’s overall risk rather than focus only on individual winning trades.","Selling Stock A and B at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should use consistent allocation and risk rules.","After shifting money into Stocks C, D and E, I should not assume that recent price moves predict what comes next; I should diversify and trade only when my plan calls for it."]}
